title: Pax Plus Vaporizer Complete & Starter Kits (taxes extra)
description:
The PAX Plus Vaporizer now comes in two kits.

Complete Kit is for Dry Herbs and Concentrates

Starter Kit is for Dry Herbs
Concentrate Adapter is not included, available for more $

The Pax Plus creates an unforgettable vaping experience for both flower and concentrate users. The portable design features a removable 3D oven screen for easy cleaning and four Experience heating modes including Stealth, Efficiency, Flavor, and Boost.

Each vaporizer also comes with two oven lids (Standard and Half-Pack) to adjust your bowl size, and a concentrate insert to switch up your session on the fly.

Experience the PAX Plus

Product Features:
– Pax Plus Starter: Flower only
– Pax Plus Complete: Dual-use vaporizer for flower and concentrate
– Four Experience heating modes including Stealth, Efficiency, Flavor, and Boost
– Removable 3D oven screen for easy cleaning
– Adjustable bowl size with two oven lid sizes included
– 22-second heat-up time
– Over two hours of continuous battery life on a single charge

Starter Kit includes:
1 x PAX Plus Vaporizer
1 x Flat Mouthpiece
1 x Raised Mouthpiece
1 x Oven Lid
1* Oven Screen
1 x Wire Brush
1 x Charge Cable

Complete Kit also includes:
1 x Concentrate Insert
1 x Half-Pack Oven Lid
1 x Multi-Tool
3 x Oven Screens
